Default Prove Up Hearing
Off Calendar Mar-18-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly this day as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing.
Dept. 218, Comm. William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Gregory J. Bulliung, Esq appeared with plaintiff Rong He Rong, who was placed under oath and testified.
No appearance by defendants Aaron Hou and Kitchen And Bath Gallery.
Defaults entered on October 30, 2007.
Doe defendants dismissed today, March 18, 2008.

After hearing the evidence presented, and good cause appearing, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff Rong He Rong and against the Defaulted Defendants: Aaron Hou and Kitchen and Bath Gallery as follows:
Damages/Principal - $48,313.00.
Costs - $535.43, for a total of $48,848.43.

Judgment was submitted to and signed by the Court.
